{{Top|leg}}
An '''espionage matrix''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component used to convert [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] and [[Service droid/Legends|service droids]] into [[espionage droid]]s. Each matrix was worth a fortune on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="Betwixt">{{WEGCite|story=There's Many a Slip Betwixt Cup and Lip|book=Mos Eisley Adventure Set}}</ref>
